title: Hast Rekha rulebook (Samudrika / Western palmistry synthesis)
purpose: Machine-readable palmistry rules for the Hast Rekha Quest app: what each line, mount, hand shape, finger and mark means, which measurable attribute changes the reading, and where the rule comes from.
disclaimer: Palmistry is a cultural and entertainment tradition, widely regarded as pseudoscience, with many conflicting interpretations (S9). The app must present readings as 'the tradition says...', never as prediction, diagnosis or advice. Many source rules (death, illness, insanity, infidelity, fertility) are recorded for completeness but flagged 'sensitivity' and must not be shown.

citation_levels.read: I read the passage; the rule is a paraphrase of it
citation_levels.toc: section confirmed from the table of contents; the rule is standard teaching consistent with that section but not line-verified

conventions.page_numbers: S1 page numbers are the printed page where the section starts (from the book's contents list). S2 is cited by Part and chapter because the OCR page numbers are unreliable.
conventions.text_policy: All wording is paraphrased. No source text is reproduced.
conventions.naming: Hindi/Sanskrit names are given where known. Where sources disagree (e.g. pitru/matru/ayu), the primary label is the one most sources agree on and the others are listed under aliases.
conventions.region_ref: Each feature that lives on the palm points to data/palm-regions.json for its joint-space region.
conventions.app_policy_fields: app_safe_reading = what the app may say; avoid_claims = what it must not say; sensitivity = category tags to filter on.
conventions.hands: Cheiro: left hand = inherited tendencies, right = developed. Modern Indian guides: dominant hand = present, other = innate (S7). Do not use the old 'men right, women left' rule (S7 calls it 'bunkum').

features.auto_detect: MEASURED from joints: palm_squareness = |index-prox to pinky-prox| / |wrist to middle-prox|; finger_ratio = |middle-prox to middle-tip| / |wrist to middle-prox|. Thresholds are population medians over 600 palmar 11k-Hands images (2D, spread palm): square if palm_squareness >= 0.64; long if finger_ratio >= 0.92. Population-relative by design (conventional 'finger longer than palm' needs a wrist-crease landmark we do not have).
